While annual earnings contracted at 38.3% per year over the last five years, the outlook has shifted; analysts now expect earnings to grow at 34.9% per year for the next three years, even as revenue growth is forecast to lag behind the broader US market at just 1.9% per year. content.summary: Lifestyle clothing conglomerate VF Corp (NYSE:VFC) reported Q3 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 3.5% year on year to $2.80 billion. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $2.90 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.52 per share was 22.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
